timestamp_semantics: Monotonic logical append time after the Campaign282 final validated state; not a market-data measurement.
objective: Freeze a finite priority-ordered catalog of economically independent issuer external-state mechanisms before any Campaign283 targeted prior-definition or source-frontier search.

catalog_selection_rule.selection_method: After this file is immutable, inspect complete local terminal-definition and source-frontier evidence in catalog priority order. Select the first route that is economically independent, has a lawful and auditable 2019-2023 point-in-time issuer identity, availability, revision and complete-market denominator contract, and is not a same-mechanism source, entity-role, jurisdiction, formula, field, window or cohort rescue. Close every sibling and parameter variant. If no route survives, terminalize Campaign283 before formula, direction, provider, fields, source rows, factor values, comparison values, prices or returns.

concept_catalog.economic_state: Issuer financial control and operating continuity reflected in public insolvency filing, administrator appointment, creditor voting, restructuring-plan confirmation, supervision, termination and discharge lifecycle records.
Issuer digital operating access reflected in public cross-border data security assessment, filing, authorization, restriction, suspension, remediation, renewal and restoration lifecycle records.

Issuer education-service capacity reflected in public accreditation, program approval, enrollment quota, admission suspension, corrective supervision, quota restoration and reauthorization lifecycle records.

Issuer logistics continuity and compliance burden reflected in public hazardous-material transport permits, route approvals, escort conditions, temporary restrictions, suspension, incident clearance and restoration lifecycle records.

Issuer generation, water-supply or site continuity reflected in public dam or reservoir inspection, hazard classification, emergency drawdown, operating restriction, remediation, acceptance and recommissioning lifecycle records.

Issuer biological-resource access and trade continuity reflected in public protected-species permits, harvest or trade quotas, detention or seizure, forfeiture, remedial conditions, release and reinstatement lifecycle records.

Issuer delivery-network access and service continuity reflected in public universal-service designation, route authorization, service-standard restriction, suspension, corrective action, route restoration and designation renewal lifecycle records.
